title: Borrowed Identities: Malleable Distillation Factories and a Unified Numerical Search
summary: Magic-state distillation is one of the leading overheads in fault-tolerant quantum computation. Existing methods for finding distillation factories require a transversal gate to act correctly on the entire codespace, a constraint that limits both generality and search efficiency. We introduce a strictly weaker borrowed-identity condition, requiring only that the distillation circuit act as the identity on a single input state.
